    About Me

    I am a Ph.D. student in the Computer Science department at the University of California, Santa Barbara. I am advised by Prof. Tim Sherwood and Prof. Jonathan Balkind. My interdisciplinary research spans Computer Architecture, Machine Learning, Sustainable Systems and Responsible Computing. I completed my undergraduate studies at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Gandhinagar, where I earned a B.Tech. degree in Computer Science and Engineering.
